# Customs Data
# Customs data
The firm panel is constructed from the imports and exports assessments of formal firms in Uganda. It contains 43 to 45 variables and runs from FY2013/14 to FY2021/22. The number of import assessments range from 670,000 to 887000 per year. The number of export assessments range from 122,000 to 300,000 per year
